title: 'Spending is leading to earnings': Wall Street strategists see payoff from Big Tech's AI investment
title_zh: “支出带来收益”：华尔街策略师看到大型科技公司人工智能投资的回报
summary: Wall Street sees booming cloud growth as a sign that AI spending is giving a return on investment.
summary_zh: 华尔街将蓬勃发展的云计算视为人工智能支出正在带来投资回报的迹象。

title: Meta to face massive social media addiction trial Tuesday
title_zh: Meta 周二将面临大规模社交媒体成瘾审判
summary: A lawsuit filed by 29 attorneys general related to Meta's impact on teens will go to trial Tuesday.
summary_zh: 由 29 名总检察长提起的一项与 Meta 对青少年影响有关的诉讼将于周二开庭审理。

title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl
title_zh: 在人工智能驱动的市场派对上，华尔街关注利率潘趣酒
summary: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.
summary_zh: 对大型科技公司的热情及其对人工智能的巨额投资正在推动股市再次创下历史新高。由于经济具有弹性和需求旺盛，似乎只有一个障碍可以阻碍这一进程：利率上升。

title: Key checks from Walmart and the big box stores: What to watch this week
title_zh: 沃尔玛和大型商店的关键检查：本周值得关注的内容
summary: Big box store earnings headline what should be a relatively quiet week.
summary_zh: 大型商店的财报成为本周相对平静的一周。
